result.summary: The page is mostly well-composed, but one clear data-rendering defect stands out: a delivery fee displays as '€NaN', indicating a broken numeric value. A couple of minor contrast/polish issues were also noted. Carousel edge clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff were treated as intended behavior and excluded.

issues.description: Under 'Smash Bros Burgers' in the 'Fastest near you' row, the delivery fee reads '€NaN delivery', exposing an invalid/undefined numeric value to users.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data source or parsing so the fee is a valid number, and add a fallback (e.g., 'Free delivery', 'Delivery fee unavailable', or hide the line) when the value is null/NaN. Format currency with a safe formatter that never outputs NaN.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray background, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio for readable text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (e.g., #6B7280 or darker) or darken the field background slightly to meet WCAG AA contrast.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', 'DELIVER TO') uses a fairly light gray that may be hard to read at small sizes.
issues.suggestion: Increase the gray darkness for small secondary text to ensure at least 4.5:1 contrast against the white background.
